label: In no accessible history at any moment is anything its own efficient cause
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history accessible from the selected world and at every moment, nothing is then and there its own efficient cause, in any respect. It is the all-histories, all-moments version of the selected-time no-self-efficient-cause premise 8b2561cd. It is stronger than 8b2561cd (and than the all-admitted-times single-world d15ded6f) only given that the selected world is accessible from itself (accessibility is not reflexive by construction) and that their unindexed relation is read as EfficientlyCausesAt at the selected world and a selected moment. The Aquinas claim on 8b2561cd does not extend to it; the 'nec est possibile' of ST I q.2 a.3 is an unchecked candidate basis.
